description: Diff two texts: unified line diff byte-compatible with GNU diff -u (hunks, context, "No newline at end of file"), or word-level / character-level diff with [-removed-]{+added+} inline markup and merged ops. Myers shortest edit script with a patience fallback for very different inputs; options to ignore whitespace, case and CRLF/LF. Returns added/removed/unchanged counts and a similarity ratio. Offline; 20,000 lines or tokens per text. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/text-diff

ignore_eol.description: Treat CRLF and LF as equal (default true)

ignore_whitespace.description: Treat runs of whitespace as equal

mode.description: unified (default, alias line), word or char

name: text_diff
title: Text Diff
